On-screen hook:
Sell from TikTok Shop without torching trust.

Spoken:
Affiliate content goes bad when the product is random and the post feels like rent is due.

Before you promote anything, ask:

Would I talk about this without the commission?
Does this solve a real problem for my audience?
Can I make more than one useful post about it?
Would I still trust myself after posting it seven times?

The product has to fit the relationship.

That is what protects the sale.
